stake.definition:
n. instrument of execution consisting of a vertical post that a victim is tied to for burning
n. the money risked on a gamble
n. a strong wooden or metal post with a point at one end so it can be driven into the ground
v. mark with a stake
stake.translation:
n. 桩, 炮烙刑, 木柱, 赌注, 奖金
vt. 打桩, 用桩撑, 下赌注, 资助
vi. 打赌

stake out.translation:
立桩标出, 监视
[法] 盯梢, 派警察监视嫌疑犯或某一地方

stake out claim.translation: [法] 立界标标明所有权, 坚持要求

stake race.translation: 马主下注的赛马[亦作 stakes race]

stake-out.translation: [法] 警察埋伏或监视某一地方

stake-outs.translation: (stake-out 的复数) [法] 警察埋伏或监视某一地方

staked.translation: vt. 用桩支撑（stake的过去式与过去分词形式）

stakeholder.definition: n. someone entrusted to hold the stakes for two or more persons betting against one another; must deliver the stakes to the winner
stakeholder.translation:
n. 赌金保管者
[法] 赌款保存人, 保存保证金的人

stakeholder pension.translation: n. 存托养老金计划（英国的一种低管理费用的养老金）

stakeholders.definition: n. someone entrusted to hold the stakes for two or more persons betting against one another; must deliver the stakes to the winner
stakeholders.translation: n. 赌金保管者( stakeholder的复数形式 )

stakeholding.translation: n. 利益相关者；赌金保管者 (stakeholder的变形)

stakeout.definition: n. surveillance of some place or some person by the police (as in anticipation of a crime)

stakeouts.definition: n. surveillance of some place or some person by the police (as in anticipation of a crime)
stakeouts.translation: n. 监视( stakeout的复数形式 )

stakers.translation: (staker 的复数) 桩支撑的植物

stakes.definition:
n the money risked on a gamble
n (law) a right or legal share of something; a financial involvement with something
n a pole or stake set up to mark something (as the start or end of a race track)
n instrument of execution consisting of a vertical post that a victim is tied to for burning
n the money risked on a gamble
n a strong wooden or metal post with a point at one end so it can be driven into the ground
v put at risk
v place a bet on
v mark with a stake
v tie or fasten to a stake
v kill by piercing with a spear or sharp pole
stakes.translation: n. 利益；赌注；风险（stake的复数）

stakhanoff.translation: 斯达汉诺夫(Alexei Grigorievich, 苏联煤矿工人, 1935年创始采煤合理化的方法), 斯达汉诺夫式工作者

stakhanovite.translation: a. 斯达汉诺夫运动的

stakhanovites.translation: (Stakhanovite 的复数) adj.斯达汉诺夫运动的
